name: Manastorm Westfall: stand-in Marisa du'Paige carries the native Manastorm boss health
contract: Segment 526 runs the native Manastorm objective Marisa du'Paige (84270) through the stock template 599, which
our world database has instead. The stock template's HealthModifier is 1.5 while the native one is 60.6562
(AscensionDB client captures, 2026-07-02 to 2026-09-09, revision d6494ceb3150), so the boss had about
1/40 of the intended health and did not scale. Manastorm now applies the native/stand-in modifier ratio to
the objective boss before depth scaling and Chaotic Link, so its maximum health lies in the native range.

steps.label: The player entered a private Manastorm instance
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so the boss is visible to this lane
Leaving the preparation bubble at the boss clears its safety aura
Marisa's maximum health uses the native Manastorm modifier
